description: The file 'subsysterms.md' documents the concept of subsystems within the Thunder framework. It explains how subsystems are abstract categories of functionality (such as Network, Graphics, Internet, etc.) that can be marked as active or inactive by plugins. It details mechanisms for querying, setting, and monitoring subsystems, including interface implementations, change notifications, and plugin metadata dependencies related to subsystems.
published: Fragmented; primarily conceptual and procedural documentation rather than code symbols

classes.name: InternetInfo
classes.description: A sample implementation of the IInternet interface, used by plugins to provide Internet subsystem metadata such as IP address and network type.

methods.name: InternetInfo::PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current IP address, or 'Unknown' if not set.

methods.name: InternetInfo::NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (UNKNOWN, IPV4, IPV6).
